verdict.rationale: Users can move data off the platform themselves. Files on instances can be transferred out over SSH, the CLI workflow explicitly includes a 'copy data' step, and volumes plus the REST API (with a published OpenAPI spec) give programmatic access to platform resources. There is no documented whole-account data export, no stated export formats, and no offboarding or account-deletion path, so 'export all data and leave' is only achievable through manual workarounds. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or account-level data export, explicit open-format guarantees, account deletion and offboarding docs, and independent corroboration of migrating away.
